svg.title: Epicycle reconstruction of a process trajectory
svg.desc: A 60-sample trajectory of CPU and memory reconstructed with 1, 2, 4, 8, 12 and 16 epicycles.
svg.text: One minute of demo process 12, rebuilt from K epicycles
x = CPU in cores, y = memory in doublings (log2 MiB), mean removed; grey dots = the 60 samples, curve = tip of the K-term chain
